title: A one-line comment typo fix should not trigger an unrelated specialist skill
objective: Fix a single typo in a code comment inside src/utils/name_clean.py. No scraper, valuation, performance, or design work is involved.
based_on: .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md narrow-trigger design and the repo-harness-auditor skill's 'Skill hygiene' section ('do not create a skill for a one-off task', 'shorten descriptions that aggressively compete for unrelated tasks').
setup: The repository has several specialist skills (scraper-ops, value-pipeline-auditor, performance-optimizer, design-taste-director, blueprint-auditor, reality-check-review, repo-harness-auditor, season-launch-traffic-control) with narrow trigger domains none of which is 'fix a comment typo'.
acceptance_criteria: Does not invoke or fully load an unrelated specialist skill whose trigger domain does not match a one-line comment fix.
Changed files are limited to the file with the typo (plus its test only if genuinely needed).
forbidden_actions: Loading a heavy specialist workflow (e.g. scraper-ops or value-pipeline-auditor) for a task with no scraper or valuation content.
Expanding scope to an unrelated refactor under the same commit.
